bitcoin_node_h1: Yadda ake gudanar da node na Bitcoin
bitcoin_node_description: Gudanar da naka node na Bitcoin yana ba ka damar tabbatar da ma'amaloli da kanka, yin ma'amala a sirrance, da kuma tallafa wa hanyar sadarwar. Wannan jagora ta ƙunshi kayan masarufi da manhajojin da kake bukata, daga saitin tsohon laptop kyauta zuwa kayan aiki da ake toshewa kawai a fara aiki.
bitcoin_node_header_subtitle: Tabbatar da kuɗinka da kanka. Node na Bitcoin yana ba ka damar duba ƙa'idodin da kanka, yin ma'amala a sirrance, da daina dogaro ga sabar wasu mutane.
bitcoin_node_s1_c1: Node na Bitcoin kwamfuta ce wadda ke saukar da dukkan blockchain na Bitcoin tana kuma tabbatar da kowace ma'amala da kanta bisa ƙa'idodin hanyar sadarwar.
bitcoin_node_s1_c2: Kowa zai iya gudanar da node. Kayan masarufi na iya zama mai sauƙi kamar tsohon laptop, ko kuma na'ura da aka riga aka gina wadda ta zo a shirye don a toshe ta a fara aiki. Zaɓi zaɓin da ya dace da kasafin kuɗinka da yawan saitin da kake son yi:
bitcoin_node_question_1: Menene node na Bitcoin kuma me ya sa ake gudanar da shi?
bitcoin_node_s2_c1: Node na Bitcoin manhaja ce wadda ke saukar da kowane block na Bitcoin da aka taɓa hakowa kuma tana sake duba kowace ma'amala bisa ƙa'idodin yarjejeniyar tsarin.
bitcoin_node_s2_c2: Lokacin da ka gudanar da node, ka daina dogaro ga ra'ayin kowa game da blockchain. Kana tabbatar da naka asusu, naka ma'amaloli, da iyakar samar da Bitcoin miliyan 21 kai tsaye daga tushe.
bitcoin_node_s2_c3: Hakanan yana ba ka sirri: walat ɗinka zai iya tambayar naka node maimakon fitar da adireshinka zuwa sabar wasu mutane.
bitcoin_node_s2_c4: Kuma yana ƙarfafa hanyar sadarwar. Kowane ƙarin node yana sa Bitcoin ya zama mai wahalar takurawa ko kai masa hari.
bitcoin_node_question_2: Wace irin kayan masarufi nake bukata?
bitcoin_node_s3_c1: Node na Bitcoin ba ya bukatar abu mai yawa. Mafi ƙarancin abin da ake bukata shi ne kwamfuta wadda za ta iya kasancewa a kunne, haɗin intanet, da kusan 700 GB na sararin diski mara amfani (blockchain ya kai ~620 GB kuma yana ƙaruwa a hankali).
bitcoin_node_s3_c2: Saituna na yau da kullum, daga mafi arha zuwa mafi sauƙi:
bitcoin_node_s3_c3: Tsohon laptop ko desktop da kake da shi — sanya Bitcoin Core kyauta. Raspberry Pi 5 tare da SSD na waje wanda ke gudanar da Bitcoin Core ko RaspiBlitz — ƙasa da $200 gaba ɗaya. Ƙananan mini PC don aiki mafi kyau da ƙarin sarari. Ko node da aka riga aka gina daga mai siyarwa kamar Umbrel, Start9, ko Nodl wanda ke zuwa a shirye don a toshe.
bitcoin_node_s3_c4: Idan sararin diski ya yi ƙaranci, Bitcoin Core yana goyon bayan yanayin pruned wanda ke jefar da tsofaffin bayanan block bayan tabbatarwa. Node na pruned na ci gaba da tabbatar da komai amma yana bukatar ~10 GB na diski kawai.
bitcoin_node_question_3: Shin ina bukatar barin shi a kunne 24/7?
bitcoin_node_s4_c1: A'a. Kana iya gudanar da node lokacin da kake bukata kawai, amma lokacin da yake aiki yana da muhimmanci saboda dalilai biyu.
bitcoin_node_s4_c2: Na farko, daidaitawa. Node wanda ya kasance a kashe yana bukatar ya cim ma duk sabbin block ɗin kafin ka iya amfani da shi. Tsawon lokacin da yake a kashe, tsawon lokacin jira.
bitcoin_node_s4_c3: Na biyu, lafiyar hanyar sadarwa. Node wanda yake a kunne kullum yana taimakawa wajen aika block ɗin da ma'amaloli zuwa wasu node a duniya.
bitcoin_node_question_4: Shin node ɗina zai iya gudanar da Lightning kuma?
bitcoin_node_s5_c1: Eh. Yawancin manhajojin node (Umbrel, Start9, myNode, Nodl) na iya gudanar da node na Lightning a saman node na Bitcoin na asali, ta amfani da naka tabbatacciyar blockchain a matsayin tushen gaskiya.
bitcoin_node_s5_c2: Lightning hanyar sadarwa ce ta daban don ma'amaloli na Bitcoin masu sauri da arha. Gudanar da naka node na Lightning yana ba ka 'yancin kai iri ɗaya don ma'amaloli kamar yadda node na Bitcoin ke ba ka don ajiya — amma yana da wahala wajen kulawa (channels, liquidity, backups).
bitcoin_node_s5_c3a: Idan kai sabo ne ga node, fara da node na asali na Bitcoin tukuna. Sannan ka ƙara Lightning daga baya idan ka ji daɗi. Duba
bitcoin_node_s5_c3c: don ƙarin bayani game da damammaki da rashin amfani.
